proposed_amendments.proposed: for levered BDCs use L3 / total-investments (not L3/NAV), because L3/NAV exceeds 100% under leverage and the moat is about the fraction of the markable book the market cannot re-mark
proposed_amendments.reason: literal L3/NAV gives 205-236% for ARCC/FSK/GBDC, which is meaningless; L3/investments (97.8/101.4/100.0%) is the economically correct moat figure. Original L3/NAV still recorded.

proposed_amendments.locked_text: annualized holdings turnover below a pre-set cap (cap not numerically fixed in spec)
proposed_amendments.proposed: set cap = 30%/yr (DXYZ 5.7%, RVT 14%, GAB 11%, CET 4.6% pass; ADX 55.6% fails). Pre-register the 30% number before Phase 2 scoring.
proposed_amendments.reason: spec §6 requires a cap but did not fix the number; must be set pre-data to avoid fishing. 30% cleanly separates the low-turnover NPORT-lag-safe funds from ADX.

proposed_amendments.proposed: report BOTH L3/NAV and L3/(NAV minus Treasury-MMF-cash-sweep); RVI is 48.3% raw but ~100% ex-cash. Do NOT change the locked 50%/NAV rule for the primary test; add the ex-cash figure as a labeled secondary classification so RVI can enter an exploratory Arm-A-extended set.
proposed_amendments.reason: venture CEFs (DXYZ, RVI) hold large Treasury MMF sweeps that mechanically dilute the L3/NAV ratio; the moat lives in the deployed book. RVI is the single best lever to fix Arm-A's low-N problem. Keeping the locked rule for the primary test preserves pre-registration integrity.
proposed_amendments.status: PROPOSED, original parameter kept for primary test
